title: Lamp intake at the repair café
titleZh: 社區修理站的檯燈受理流程

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I brought a desk lamp to the repair café. The shade is fine, but the switch gets stuck halfway. Is that something you look at here?
turns.zh: 我帶了一盞檯燈來社區修理站。燈罩沒問題，但開關按到一半會卡住。你們這裡會檢查這種問題嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes. First put a blue tag on the cord. Write your name on it, then leave the lamp on the low shelf beside this desk.
turns.zh: 會。先在電線上掛一張藍色標籤，寫上姓名，然後把檯燈放在這張桌子旁的下層架上。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I can do that. I also brought the box it came in. Would you like me to leave that here too?
turns.zh: 沒問題。我也帶了原來的盒子。盒子也要留在這裡嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: No, keep the box with you. We’ll call your name when a volunteer is ready to take a look.
turns.zh: 不用，盒子請自己留著。有人可以檢查時，我們會叫你的名字。
